note: Pinned external tools (docs/PLAN_TOOLS_2026-10-20.md (T1-T4), docs/PLAN_TOOLS_C_2026-10-20.md (T5-T6: nothing is bundled; tools are installed by the user from the pinned source)). Every sha256/size below is copied from the checksum source named next to it; nothing is guessed. sha256 null = no installable official checksum, install is disabled and only manual_hint is shown. Compiled into the binary (include_str!), never read from disk at run time.

tools.name: libewf
tools.title: libewf (E01)
tools.unavailable_reason: The official release (https://github.com/libyal/libewf/releases/tag/20260924) publishes only a source tarball and its PGP signature, no Windows binaries.
tools.manual_hint: libewf는 공식 Windows 실행 파일이 없습니다 — scripts/build-libewf-tools.ps1로 소스에서 빌드하거나 직접 설치한 뒤 ewfinfo·ewfverify·ewfexport(와 DLL)를 tools/bin에 복사하십시오: https://github.com/libyal/libewf

tools.name: sleuthkit
tools.title: The Sleuth Kit (삭제 파일 복구)
tools.unavailable_reason: The maintainers publish a PGP signature (.asc), not a checksum file, and the archive's file list (exe + DLL set) could not be verified without downloading it. The GitHub-computed digest under "reference" is recorded for manual verification only.
tools.manual_hint: sleuthkit-4.15.0-win32.zip을 공식 배포처에서 받아 PGP 서명(.asc)을 확인한 뒤 mmls·fls·icat과 함께 들어 있는 DLL을 tools/bin에 복사하십시오: https://www.sleuthkit.org/sleuthkit/download.php

tools.name: deepfake-lens
tools.title: deepfake-lens (합성 영상 스크리닝)
tools.unavailable_reason: deepfake-lens is not published on PyPI (https://pypi.org/pypi/deepfake-lens/json returned 404 on 2026-10-19), so no hash-pinned requirements file can be built from PyPI's published digests.
tools.manual_hint: deepfake-lens는 PyPI에 공개되지 않아 자동 설치할 수 없습니다 — 받은 패키지를 직접 설치(pip install <경로>)하고 FRAMETRACE_DEEPFAKE_LENS에 deepfake-lens.exe 경로를 지정하십시오.
